raw_text:
Telegram bot: aiogram 3, Django 5, Celery; `/start`, automatic user tracking. Commands:
cp .env.example .env  # Then edit .env with your values
uv run python manage.py migrate
uv run python manage.py createsuperuser
uv run python manage.py runserver
uv run python main.py
uv run celery -A config worker --loglevel=info
uv run python manage.py makemigrations
uv run python manage.py test
uv run python manage.py createsuperuser
uv run python manage.py shell
Required `.env`: `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`, `DJANGO_SECRET_KEY`; optional `CELERY_BROKER_URL`, `START_COMMAND_MESSAGE`. Celery requires Redis. Admin: `/admin`. Production requires secret management/database configuration. `main.py` initializes Django ORM, aiogram Bot/Dispatcher, middleware/routes, polling. Add handlers to `bot/aiogram/handlers.py` or route
